citation: Gronwald T, et al. Front Physiol 2019;10:999
protocol: Continuous cycle-ergometer exercise at the individual anaerobic threshold until voluntary exhaustion in normoxia (NC arm; hypoxia arm to ignore); HR, SpO2, lactate and RPE at rest, warm-ups and every 10% of exercise time
note: Series of HR and lactate against percentage of time to exhaustion in normoxia; dose is the workload at IAT in W.
